text.p: Eurostar passengers in London are being flown to Brussels and Paris following a fire overnight in the Channel Tunnel linking France and Britain, officials said.
They told reporters anyone wishing to travel this morning would be taken from London to Gatwick airport by bus from where they would fly in chartered planes to Brussels and Paris.

Signs at London's Waterloo station said services on Eurostar were cancelled. Earlier Eurostar said it hoped to get express passenger trains running through the Channel Tunnel by midday. Two people were seriously injured by toxic smoke and 34 were evacuated after the fire broke out on a shuttle train carrying trucks through the tunnel, closing it to all services.
